chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa', and a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, all together from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) addressed the people and said: 'O people!
Indeed, the beginning of the occurrence of seditions is desires that are followed, and rulings that are innovated, in which the Book of God is opposed, and men take command over men therein.

For if falsehood were pure, it would not be hidden from one with intelligence. And if truth were pure, there would be no disagreement. But a bunch is taken from this and a bunch from that, and they are mixed together and come at once — and therein Satan takes hold of his allies, while those who have previously received the good decree from God are saved.

key_terms.الأهواء: Personal desires, whims, passions — following one's caprice rather than revealed guidance
key_terms.الحسنى: The best/good outcome — specifically refers to divine predestination of protection for the righteous
key_terms.الفتنة: Sedition, civil strife, trial — encompassing civil war, religious deviation, and social chaos
key_terms.ضِغث: A handful or bundle — metaphor for mixed truth and falsehood blended together
key_terms.كتاب الله: The Book of God (Quran) — the standard against which innovations are measured

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say is the root cause of sedition (fitna) in society?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identified the root cause of social and religious sedition in two interconnected phenomena: the following of personal desires and the innovation of rulings that contradict the Quran. Ali's sermon explains why fitna is so difficult to combat: it does not present itself as pure falsehood, which intelligent people could easily reject, but rather as a dangerous mixture of truth and falsehood that confuses people. The historical context of this address is the turbulent period of early Islam when competing factions were fabricating religious rulings and using selective verses to justify political authority — exactly the situation Ali witnessed during his caliphate. Only those whom God has predestined for protection (al-husna) can navigate such treacherous waters.
word_analysis: so they are both mixed together

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Al Al Washa and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, altogether from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> addressed the people, so he<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘O you people!

The start of the occurrence of the sedition is the following of personal desires and the innovation of regulations wherein the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is opposed. A man takes command of a man in it.

So if the falsehood was pure, it would not be hidden from the one with intelligence, and if the truth was pure, differings would not occur. But, a bunch is taken from this, and a bunch from this, so they are both mixed up. Thus, they are coming with both of these together. So from over here, the Satan<sup style="font-weight: normal">la</sup> takes over his<sup style="font-weight: normal">la</sup> friends! And only those who have previously received Protection Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> remain safe.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash’ari has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ and a number of our people from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal all from ‘Asim ibn Hamid from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “Imam Ali said in one of his sermons to people, ‘O people,
mischief begins with following certain desires and obeying certain invented rules that are different from the rules and laws of the book of Allah. In such case people yield to other people

as high authority if falsehood would have been clear they would have no fear for the people of Intelligence. If truth would have been clearly distinct there would have been no differences. But (practical life) people mix certain parts of truth and with a few things from falsehood and present them together and in such Satan overwhelms his friends and only those who has previously received protection from Allah remain safe.’”
